MCE MOSTRA CONVEGNO EXPOCOMFORT 2022 ｜Aquasky

 

Upcoming International Event

28 June-1 July Live / 28 June-6 July Digital

MCE MOSTRA CONVEGNO EXPOCOMFORT 2022

MOSTRA CONVEGNO EXPOCOMFORT (MCE) is the most prestigious business showcase for companies in the industry of HVAC+R, renewable energy, and energy efficiency. It has been recognized by relevant industry players all over the world as an exposition for heating, air conditioning, refrigeration, and sanitary ware, the largest and most influential benchmarking exposition in the fields of pumps and valves, piping, and new energy.

Italian government attaches great importance to the exposition, and it has been strongly supported and sponsored by the Italian Ministry of Trade, Environment and Territorial Protection, and the Ministry of Education and Research. MCE is a leading indicator of revealing market trends.

At MCE, you launch products and services on a global scale, you build effective business relationships while strengthening strategic alliances with engineers, specifiers and installers who implement solutions and systems for efficient buildings MCE increases your brand recognition and the perceived image of your organization, thus supporting your future strategies.

 

The main aspects of the exposition, "Global Comfort Technology" closely links the four themes of the exposition, Heating/Cooling/Water/Energy, to show how to provide innovative solutions for a comfortable living environment under the conditions of contemporary technology, with new products and new technologies to meet market demands and integrate into future smart buildings and cities. Visitors to MCE mainly come from installation design, system engineering, construction industry, wholesale and retail, import and export, and other fields, and have a high degree of decision-making power and purchasing power. MCE is the best platform shortcut to consolidate and deploy global business and moved towards the international market. Don't miss the biennial industry event!

 

Major items on display.

1. HEATING (heating, implements and tools, HVAC components)

Heating, automatic control, power supply system, heat meter, temperature control valve, other heating system control valve; automatic control of boiler and heating network, testing instrumentation

 

2. COOLING (air conditioning, ventilation, refrigeration)

Air conditioning equipment, ventilation equipment, commercial and industrial refrigeration and related components, tools

 

3. WATER (plumbing tech, water treatment, taps, bathroom accessories, pumps, valves)

Drinking water purification equipment, pump valves, pipe water meter accessories and tools, testing and monitoring technology equipment, bathroom water hardware, and water treatment equipment.

 

4. ENERGY (heat pumps, solar heating, PV, wind, home, and building

automation, bio-sustainable building, domotics)

Photovoltaic, solar energy, thermoelectricity, wind energy, bioenergy, symbiotic energy, insulation, energy-saving equipment, home automation control system

 

For the 2022 edition, MCE presents the new digital platform that will allow the whole community to meet and networking online. The event in the digital version will be held from 28 June to 6 July.

An extraordinary opportunity to encourage the participation of all professionals, exhibitors and visitors, even those who will not be able to take part in the live event.

 

In light of the continued impact of COVID-19, our company has decided not to take part in the MCE exposition this time. We are genuinely upset not to be able to host you at this time. However, we still have partners who will join the show.

If you are interested in our pressure tanks, please feel free to contact us.
